raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Bodyweight Strength Programme (Beginner)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build foundational upper/lower body strength with minimal equipment, progression over 12 weeks"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body Basics 1":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bodyweight_row 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          squat 3x10..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x20..40 seconds rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch  length 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Tuesday training 45m "Full Body Basics 2":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x9..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          inverted_row (use doorway bar) 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat (bodyweight if no weight) 3x12..18 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_bridge 3x12..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..40 seconds each side rpe 5
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch  length 5 minutes
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body Basics 3":
        warmup:
          high_knees 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up_progression (assisted or negative on doorway bar) 3x4..8 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          squat 3x12..18 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge march 3x12..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          planks 3x30..45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch  length 5 minutes
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Deload & Technique":
        warmup:
          march_in_place 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x6..10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          inverted_row 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bodyweight_backward_lunge 3x8..12 each leg rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          prone_hover (superman) 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 5 minutes

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          pull_up_progression 4x4..8 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          step_up_with_dive_thrust (use doorway if available) 4x8..12 each leg rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_shoulder_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Focus":
        warmup:
          leg_m swings 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x12..18 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge march 4x12..20 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          ab_work_cycle 3x20 reps of chosen core moves
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Pull Progressions":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up_progression 4x4..8 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          inverted_row 4x6..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          pistol_branch_counter (assisted) 3x6..10 per leg
          plank 3x40..60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Thursday training 50m "Stability & Volume":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x10..15 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          row_variant (bodyweight row) 4x8..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          squat 4x12..20 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x15..25 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 5 minutes

  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength Peak Prep":
        warmup:
          dynamic_mobility_routine 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up_progression 5x4..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          squat 5x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility_cooldown 5 minutes
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Push/Pull Intensity":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press (sub if no incline: push_up) 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row (or inverted_row) 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          squat with tempo 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank_variation 3x45..60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower Body Strength":
        warmup:
          leg_mobility 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat (use household item as weight) 5x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lunge 4x8..12 per leg rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 5x12..20 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calk_raise (standing or seated) 4x12..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Thursday training 60m "Deload & Review":
        warmup:
          march_in_place 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x6..10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bodyweight_circuit: 3 rounds of 10 reps each of air_squat, glute_bridge, plank 30s
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 5 minutes

SYNTAX RULES APPLY:
- Rep ranges use two dots: 3x8..12
- Sets always first: 3x10
- RPE after: rpe 7
- Rest in seconds: rest 60 seconds
- Exercises use canonical names only from list
- Cardio modalities used only for warmups/cooldowns: walking, jogging_in_place, high_knees, etc. (Within allowed: running, cycling, swimming, rowing, elliptical, jump_rope, walking, hiking)
- If a requested exercise not in vocab, substitute closest canonical name
- Plan remains beginner-friendly, no equipment beyond pushups, doorway pull-up bar, and bodyweight accessories
- Ensure structure follows PLAN TYPE VISIBILITY GOALS PHASES sections
